name: EIA Form 861 Electric Power Industry Data
known_limitations: Form 861 is an annual utility-data census with a reporting lag. It does not establish current feeder capacity, a specific interconnection outcome, a project service commitment, or near-real-time grid conditions.
automation_notes: Use utility and balancing-authority identifiers to select service-territory, customer, sales, demand-response, distributed-energy, and reliability tables while preserving the reporting year.
notes: Promoted from the private candidate layer in Phase 55E after live review of the official EIA release page.
